text: {"rules":[{"id":"HIV-PREP-INCREASED-RISK","version":"August 2023","title":"Prevention of Acquisition of HIV: Preexposure Prophylaxis for adolescents and adults at increased risk of HIV","source_quote":"The USPSTF recommends that clinicians prescribe preexposure prophylaxis using effective antiretroviral therapy to persons who are at increased risk of HIV acquisition to decrease the risk of acquiring HIV.","grade":"A","effective_date":"August 2023","action":"Prescribe preexposure prophylaxis (PrEP) using effective antiretroviral therapy","denominator":"{\"uncomputable\": {\"needs\": \"HIV acquisition risk assessment (sexual behavior, injection drug use, partner HIV status, clinician judgment)\"}, \"quote\": \"persons who are at increased risk of HIV acquisition\"}","numerator":"{\"uncomputable\": {\"needs\": \"record of PrEP prescription with effective antiretroviral therapy (grammar has no medication/prescription criterion type)\"}, \"quote\": \"prescribe preexposure prophylaxis using effective antiretroviral therapy\"}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["Increased-risk status depends on sexual behavior, drug use and exposure history not reliably held in structured EHR data, so the denominator is uncomputable; the engine will report this rule as not computable.","The numerator (PrEP prescribed) is encoded as uncomputable because the criterion grammar has no medication/prescription type; a new concept such as 'hiv_prep_prescription' would be needed if a medication criterion type is added. It is not in the concept vocabulary.","No age criterion encoded: the population 'adolescents and adults' is stated only in the topic with no numeric age bounds, so any age cutoff would be invented.","No exclusion for existing HIV infection was encoded because the section text does not state one (PrEP is implicitly for HIV-negative persons; the Practice Considerations section is referenced but not included).","The section refers to the Practice Considerations section for identification of persons at increased risk and for which antiretroviral regimens are effective; that content (product choice, dosing, HIV testing before/during PrEP, monitoring) is not in this section and is not represented.","The DATE field carries an asterisk ('August 2023 *') whose footnote is not included in the section text."]}
